title: A set lying in a translate of a coordinate n-plane V_ι can only have V_ι as approximate tangent space, and unit orientations of it are ±e_ι (Simon Ch. 6, (26)–(27); step 3 of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing, A ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P), x ∈ ℝ^P, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P and ξ an n-vector (MultiVector P n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors). Assume (i) a_i = x_i for every a ∈ A and every coordinate i ∉ range ι; (ii) A has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4: dim Q = n and ∫_{blowUpMap x λ '' A} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where blowUpMap x λ y = λ⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]); (iii) ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q). Then either ξ(α) = α(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}) for every n-covector α (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))
